info.title: Walkitecture API
info.description: Floor-plan ingestion (DWG/DXF), canonical building model, validated edits, and natural-language edit interpretation.

post.description: OAuth2 password flow (form-encoded); used by the Swagger UI 'Authorize' button.

Upload a DWG/DXF. By default this runs the whole pipeline: DWG -> DXF -> descriptive drawing JSON ->
building model -> Babylon.js scene, all stored for this plan. Parse failures are recorded on the plan.

schema.title: Response List Plans Api Plans Get

post.description: Create and parse the built-in two-bedroom sample plan (a known-good DXF).
(Re)run the pipeline with custom options (units, wall style, layer names...). Clears edit history.

get.description: Descriptive JSON of the drawing: every entity's geometry and classification, layers, and blocks.

parameters.name: entities

schema.description: Include the per-entity list (can be large).
schema.title: Entities

parameters.description: Include the per-entity list (can be large).

schema.title: Response Get Drawing Api Plans  Plan Id  Drawing Get

get.description: The canonical building JSON plus the Babylon.js scene generated from it.

put.description: Replace the building model with a hand-authored one (fully validated). Undoable.

get.description: Download the uploaded file, or the DXF that a DWG was converted to.

post.description: Apply one allowlisted edit. Returns the new model, its Babylon scene, and the IDs to rebuild.

schema.title: Response Edit History Api Plans  Plan Id  Edits Get

post.description: Turn text + selected ID + model context into a typed edit command, validate it, and optionally apply it.

coordinateSystem.title: Coordinatesystem
coordinateSystem.default: Babylon world space, y up; plan x -> x, plan y -> z

size.title: Size
size.description: [width (local x, along the wall), height, depth (local z, wall thickness)]

rotationY.title: Rotationy
rotationY.description: Radians; aligns local +x with the wall direction

position.title: Position
position.description: First-person spawn point at eye height

baseVersion.title: Baseversion
baseVersion.description: Model version the client edited against; mismatches return 409.

factor.title: Factor
factor.description: Width multiplier applied to every window.

category.title: Category
category.description: bed, chair, sofa, desk, table, closet, toilet

facing.title: Facing
facing.description: Unit vector the model's front points to (away from the nearest wall)

width.title: Width
width.description: Footprint extent across the facing direction (m)

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Footprint extent along the facing direction (m)

FurnitureItem.title: FurnitureItem
FurnitureItem.description: A piece of furniture matched to a GLB model from the frontend furniture library.

url.title: Url
url.description: Path of the GLB in the frontend furniture library

position.title: Position
position.description: Position of a parent TransformNode holding the imported GLB

rotationY.title: Rotationy
rotationY.description: Radians, so the model's front (glTF +z) points along `facing`

scaling.title: Scaling
scaling.description: Per-axis scale fitting the drawing's footprint and a realistic height

footprintCenter.title: Footprintcenter
footprintCenter.description: Where the scaled model's footprint center ends up (on the floor)

planId.title: Planid
planId.description: Use the stored model of this plan as context.

model.description: Inline model context (when no planId is given).

cameraForward.title: Cameraforward
cameraForward.description: Camera forward direction in plan coordinates; resolves 'forward'/'back'.

apply.title: Apply
apply.description: Also apply the command to planId if it validates.

valid.title: Valid
valid.description: Whether the command passes validation (null if unknown).

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Signed distance in meters along the wall's left-hand normal (perpendicular, to the left when looking from start to end).

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Distance (m) along the wall from its start point to the opening's left edge.

units.title: Units
units.description: Drawing units. 'auto' reads $INSUNITS from the file and guesses from extents if missing.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Explicit drawing-units -> meters multiplier (calibration). Overrides units.

wallStyle.title: Wallstyle
wallStyle.description: 'centerline': each wall-layer line is a wall centerline. 'double_line': walls are drawn as parallel face lines (2 or more per wall); thickness is inferred. 'auto': double_line when most wall lines have a parallel partner, else centerline.

placeFurniture.title: Placefurniture
placeFurniture.description: Match furniture blocks to the GLB library.

openingLayers.title: Openinglayers
openingLayers.description: Mixed door/window layers: blocks with a swing arc become doors, others windows.

ParseOptions.title: ParseOptions
ParseOptions.description: Per-request overrides for plan parsing. Omitted fields fall back to server settings.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: A single validation failure, safe to show to end users.

sillHeight.title: Sillheight
sillHeight.description: Absolute new sill height in meters.

model.description: Canonical building JSON (source of truth for edits)

babylon.description: Render-ready Babylon.js scene generated from the model
